verdict.rationale: Replit documents adding AI to generated apps ("Enhance your apps with AI... Connect to OpenAI"). Its connector system lets an admin set up a service once so builders can use it across apps, which suggests builders avoid handling credentials. However, no evidence says AI or LLM calls work without the user supplying or managing provider keys; the no-keys claim (docs-13) covers auth only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in, keyless LLM access for apps; evidence of agent features inside generated apps; confirmation that connectors cover AI providers without user-held keys; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself

citations.quote: Enhance your apps with AI and 100+ integrations. Connect to OpenAI, Stripe, Google Workspace, and more in minutes.
Centralized management: Admin sets up a service once; builders use it across apps in that workspace.
